title: Signed SWAP lower exchange with Ribasim-owned surface-water availability
purpose: Qualify the ownership seam for signed lower exchange: SWAP computes the unconstrained constitutive drainage/infiltration request from accepted hydraulic state, Ribasim owns the surface-water store and may constrain withdrawals, and the coupler must treat any difference between requested and realized exchange as a coupled-trial feasibility result rather than clipping an already accepted SWAP transfer.

authorities.legacy_exchange: F-PM08D2 exact-source restricted extended drainage exchange readiness

frozen_swap_exchange_branch.surface_route: resolved external secondary water level, SWSRF=2 semantics
formula: resolved drain level = external Ribasim water level because WL > ZBOTDR+0.001 in all cases
effective head difference = GWL-WL; no ponding or GWLINF cap is active
frozen_swap_exchange_branch.sign: q_swap > 0 soil->surface water; q_swap < 0 surface water->soil

frozen_ribasim_mapping.positive_q: basin.Static drainage = q_swap depth/day * represented area / day
frozen_ribasim_mapping.negative_q: basin.Static infiltration = abs(q_swap) depth/day * represented area / day

cases.expectation: Ribasim realized cumulative infiltration is nonnegative, strictly below requested transfer, cannot exceed available surface-water storage within tolerance, and final storage remains nonnegative. No exact realized value is preregistered because the pinned Ribasim low-storage reduction policy is part of the external feasibility realization being measured.

coupling_decision_rule.if_realized_equals_requested: candidate transfer may proceed to joint acceptance, subject to the normal coupled transaction.
coupling_decision_rule.if_realized_differs_from_requested: candidate is not an accepted SWAP transfer. Coupler must expose the realized feasible transfer and recompose/re-evaluate SWAP and Ribasim from the same accepted origins before commit.
coupling_decision_rule.forbidden: accept SWAP with requested infiltration and then clip only the Ribasim side.

pass_criteria: X1 source-derived q=+1 cm/day and direct Ribasim cumulative drainage=0.01 m3 within tolerance; storage and level increase consistently.
X2 source-derived q=-0.5 cm/day and direct Ribasim cumulative infiltration=0.005 m3 within tolerance; storage and level decrease consistently.
X3 source-derived request is -0.51 cm/day, but Ribasim limits the physical withdrawal before storage becomes negative.
All three direct Ribasim mass ledgers close within the frozen residual tolerance.
The harness marks X3 as RECOMPOSITION_REQUIRED rather than ACCEPT_WITH_CLIP.
nonclaims: No full real-SWAP runtime composition yet.
No multilevel mixed-sign proportional legacy limiter qualification.
